tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Malik.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Priya.
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table II — 2 people, 29 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the west ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table II's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
🧳 A traveler says Thornfield burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table II is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
